'''2003 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Minnesota (21 June 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 21 June 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Venue:''' Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Jim Li]]<ref name="pc-us03" />

The championship was the Saturday of the Minnesota State Championship Weekend (20–21 June 2003) at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights: six games of Swiss and a final confrontation between the top two, with $100, $50 and $25 to the top three, the Day 2 bye to the winner<ref name="pc-mnweekend">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030822034604/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/mnstatesweekend04182003.htm The 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 August 2003.</ref> and glass trophies for the top 4.<ref name="pcf-1291">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291&amp 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (10 April – 20 June 2003), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 18 March 2004.</ref> The Friday sealed deck tournament drew 38 players.<ref name="pcf-1291" /> [[Jim Li]] won the Day 2 bye.<ref name="pc-us03" />
